context: Two friends chat at the cafe about a TV variety show
purpose: Teach: 判ら/ヘルプ/あいまい/ステキ/ジョーク/ボリューム/終始/輝く

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日のバラエティ番組、見た？司会者が終始笑ってて、なんかこっちまで楽しくなったよ。
lines.en: Did you see that variety show last night? The host was smiling the whole time, it made me happy too.
lines.style: Warm casual barista tone, friendly and slightly excited

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 見た見た！ゲストの女優さんがステキだったよね。目がキラキラ輝くみたいで、画面越しでもわかった。
lines.en: I saw it! The guest actress was lovely, wasn't she? Her eyes were sparkling even through the screen.
lines.style: Dreamy romantic delivery, soft and admiring with sighs

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あのコーナーで芸人が軽いジョークを連発してたけど、半分くらい意味が判らなかったんだよね、私。
lines.en: That comedian kept throwing out little jokes in that segment, but honestly I didn't get half of them.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh, casual and a little embarrassed

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私もあいまいに笑ってごまかしたタイプ。たぶん関西のネタだったんじゃないかな。
lines.en: I just laughed vaguely to play it off. I think it might have been Kansai-style humor.
lines.style: Soft conspiratorial whisper, slightly playful and uncertain

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 観客の笑い声で台詞がかき消されちゃってさ、ボリューム上げて、配信アプリのヘルプ見ながら字幕オンにしたよ。
lines.en: The audience laughter drowned out the lines, so I cranked up the volume and turned on subtitles by checking the streaming app's help section.
lines.style: Animated storytelling, slightly frustrated then proud of solution

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 賢い！私それ知らなかった。今度から使ってみる。
lines.en: Smart! I didn't know that existed. I'll try it next time.
lines.style: Impressed and genuinely curious, voice rising in delight

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 来週のゲスト、あの若手俳優らしいよ。スキャンダル後の初出演だって。
lines.en: Apparently next week's guest is that young actor. It's his first appearance since the scandal.
lines.style: Lowered gossipy tone, leaning in with quiet intrigue

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ええ、絶対録画する。コーヒーおかわりして、続きの予告も見ようよ。
lines.en: No way, I'm definitely recording it. Let me get a refill and let's watch the preview together.
lines.style: Excited and warm, inviting tone with rising enthusiasm
